bio: Welcome to The Adria’s Afternoon Tea experience, where tradition meets contemporary elegance in the heart of South Kensington.  Join us as we celebrate the rich history of Afternoon Tea, a quintessentially British tradition, in a setting that pays homage to the legacy of tea itself. As you indulge in our meticulously crafted menu, adorned with delicacies inspired by centuries of tea culture, you will be transported through time with a showcase of historic tea-ware graciously on loan from the renowned Chitra Collection and curated by Evelyn Earl.  Join us in our dining room as we celebrate the rich history of Afternoon Tea, a quintessentially British tradition, in a setting that pays homage to the legacy of tea itself  In the heart of exclusive South Kensington, The Adria is much more than a boutique hotel. Behind the stucco façade of our 19th-century townhouse, you will discover a contemporary style designed to meet every modern comfort. Just a short walk from the Natural History Museum, Harrods department store and the Royal Albert Hall, this exclusive five-star hotel has a nostalgic members’ club charm.
